Check your pet’s current condition first.
Pause strenuous activity and allow natural rest; review the 120-second heart-rate and breathing curves. Do not increase exertion to retest.
If valid readings remain markedly abnormal or your pet seems unwell, contact a vet today.
If your pet now has laboured breathing, blue or pale gums, collapse or inability to stand, seek emergency veterinary care immediately; do not wait for another reading.
